name: cli-session-coordinator
body: The session coordinator: the live server that owns the worktree's `apg/.trans/db.lbug` and the extended `apg/.trans/specs.lock` for its life, binds the session socket, admits durable node/edge mutations in receive order, projects each into the live index, holds the pending node-file writes and deletes, and flushes them at a save as one atomic write plus one commit.
